help.title: How this copy works
help.heading: No USB key needed
help.p1: The original program asked for a USB security key before it would start. This copy opens straight into the workspace on any computer: there is no key check at all.
help.p2: It also never goes online. There is no licence, update or telemetry service inside the program, so nothing can be sent anywhere while you work.
help.tool.select: pick an object, drag to move it, reorder it with the buttons under the list
help.tool.run: drag a line that becomes a run stitch
help.tool.satin: drag a centre line that becomes a satin column
help.tool.pan: drag the workspace; scroll to zoom anywhere
help.rulers.heading: Measuring on the hoop
help.rulers: A ruler runs along the four edges of the hoop: one short mark for every millimetre, a longer mark every five and a number every ten. The centre of the hoop is 0, so the numbers on the edge match the position fields on the right. Hide the rulers from the View menu or with the ruler button in the toolbar.
help.files.text: Designs save as their own project file. DST stitch files can be imported as well as exported, so designs you already have will open here; drawings export as SVG and the full stitch list as CSV.
help.built.text: This is a native desktop program written in Rust and drawn with the egui/eframe interface toolkit.
help.langs: You can change language at the top right. Every label comes from the files in the lang folder, so any wording can be corrected there.
about.title: How it is built
about.subtitle: An embroidery workspace for drawing, previewing and exporting designs
about.p1: Rust builds one native program file. There is no separate runtime, framework or installer to keep on the computer.
about.p2: egui draws the whole window itself, so the look is consistent everywhere and the program stays small and quick.
about.p3: There is no licence client or online service in the program, so it works the same with the network cable out.
about.p4: The original program and its folder were never opened, copied or changed; this is a separate program built from your description of what you needed.
about.value.designs: own project format, DST, SVG, CSV

help.example: The program opens on a flower example that is exactly 8 × 8 cm. Reload it at any time from File → Flower example, or start a blank design with New.
msg.choose_where: Choose where to save the design.
summary.rate_tip: Sewing speed used for the estimated time — type any value to make the time exact.
help.sizes.heading: Hoop size and sewing time
help.sizes: The hoop is not limited to the ready-made sizes: type any width and height in millimetres and the fabric and the rulers follow, so the design is checked against the hoop you really use. Stitches per second is the sewing speed used for the estimated time: change it and the time is recalculated immediately, stitches divided by speed.
hoop.tip: Type any width and height in millimetres; the presets above just fill them in.
